signin.title: Sign in to QuickWork
signin.description: Enter your email to get a login code
signin.brand_line: Give a squad a task and it becomes one: every leg runs on its holder's own agent, and the baton passes on only after they approve it — context and output shared the whole way.

relay.park_note: {{name}} hasn't bound an agent — the task waits on that leg, not skipped and not failed.
relay.ctx_line: The brief and everyone's handoff packages live on this thread.
relay.res_line: My agent runs on my own machine and directories.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.description: We sent a verification code to {{email}}

cli.title: Authorize CLI
cli.description: Allow the CLI to access QuickWork as {{email}}

errors.server_unreachable: Make sure the server is running.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment before requesting another code.
errors.cli_auth_failed: Failed to authorize CLI. Please log in again.

desktop_handoff.opening_description: You should see a prompt to open the QuickWork desktop app. If nothing happens, click the button below.

recovery.title: Reconnecting to QuickWork
recovery.description: Your session is still saved. We'll retry automatically when the connection recovers.
